GDM does not cause congenital anomalies. Such malforma-
tions occur in women with diabetes before pregnancy who have 
uncontrolled blood glucose levels during the first 6 to 8 weeks 
of pregnancy when fetal organs are being formed. Because 
GDM does not appear until later in pregnancy, the fetal organs 
were formed before hyperglycemia became a problem.
When optimal blood glucose levels are not being maintained 
with MNT or the rate of fetal growth is excessive, pharmaco-
logic therapy is needed (AND, 2008b).
